title: Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Survey on Agentic RAG
text: Agentic RAG extends retrieval augmented generation by allowing agents to plan, use tools, search external memory, reflect on answers, and coordinate multiple steps. Multi-agent RAG systems can divide research into retrieval, reasoning, verification, and writing.

title: Orchestral AI: A Framework for Agent Orchestration
text: Orchestral AI introduces a lightweight Python framework for orchestrating LLM agents. Important ideas include provider agnostic design, unified messages, tool calling, hooks, subagents, memory management, sandboxing, reproducibility, and cost tracking.

title: Multi-Agent Systems for Academic Research Assistance
text: Academic research assistants can benefit from specialized agents. One agent can retrieve sources, another can summarize findings, another can check citations, and another can draft the final answer for a student.
